versions.content: Specification of Synchronized Time - Base Manager AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 49 of 186 Document ID 421 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SynchronizedTimeBaseManager - AUTOSAR confidential - For Pure Local Time Bases all bits of the Time Base status timeBaseStatus shall be set to 0, except for bit GLOBAL_TIME_BASE . GLOBAL_TIME_BASE shall be set to 1, by a valid invocation of StbM_S etGlobalTime() or StbM_UpdateGlobalTime() and only set to 0 by StbM_Init() .

For Pure Local Time Bases all bits of the Time Base status timeBaseStatus shall be set to 0, except for bit GLOBAL_TIME_BASE . GLOBAL_TIME_BASE shall be set to 1, by a valid invocation of StbM_S etGlobalTime() or StbM_UpdateGlobalTime() and only set to 0 by StbM_Init() .

For Pure Local Time Bases all bits of the Time Base status timeBaseStatus shall be set to 0, except for bit GLOBAL_TIME_BASE . GLOBAL_TIME_BASE shall be set to 1, by a valid invocation of StbM_S etGlobalTime() or StbM_UpdateGlobalTime() and only set to 0 by StbM_Init() .
